prog_list.description: List of program names to generate regexes for (e.g., perl, python). Overrides --prog if non-empty.

make_label.description: Label for a pre-made regex (e.g., 'hour', 'date2'). If empty, runs wizard unless other flags are set.

history_value.description: History string to replay. If empty, ignores --history.

showinfo_program.description: Program name for --showinfo (e.g., 'sed'). If empty, ignores --showinfo.
